items.t: 11 Big Funds Bought Home Depot Last Quarter, While 13 Sold. Who’s Right?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 11 bought Home Depot and 13 sold, led by GMO’s new $214 million stake and Lone Pine Capital’s exit. Two of the buyers also added Lowe’s, which trades at about 19x forward earnings against about 23x for Home Depot.
